Indian stock markets plunge sharply after weeks of gains

India's benchmark stock indices experienced a significant downturn, with the Sensex falling 1,483 points to close at 82,435 and the Nifty dropping 450 points to 25,349. This sharp decline occurred after a period of four weeks of strong gains in the market.
